title: Potion of Vitality
summary: Cures Poisoned and Diseased when drunk or splashed.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Clear Poisoned and Diseased from yourself.
fields.Throw: Action, up to 60 ft. Clear Poisoned and Diseased from creatures in a 3 ft radius.
fields.Acquisition: Goblin Camp chest near the path to Rosymorn Monastery Trail. No Alchemy recipe.

changes: Added native BG3 rules using pinned item and linked gameplay sources.
